title: Adjuvant Radiation in Aortic Valvuloplasty - ARAVA
brief_summary: This study will examine the effect of external beam radiation therapy in the prevention of restenosis following successful balloon aortic valvuloplasty in severe, symptomatic aortic stenosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe Aortic Stenosis
* NYHA Class 2-4 CHF Symptoms
* Age \> 75
* EuroSCORE \> 7
* Prohibitively High Risk for Aortic Valve Replacement Surgery as Designated by a Cardiac Surgeon
